description: This file is a front-end React component written in TypeScript, which renders a page listing shops with client-side data fetching, UI elements, and interactions such as copying IDs and setting active shops.

methods.name: ShopsPage
methods.description: Main React component function that displays the list of shops with loading, error, and data views.

methods.name: fetchShops
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch shop data from API and manage loading/error states.

methods.name: onSetActive
methods.description: Callback to set a shop as active and show a toast notification.

methods.name: onCopyId
methods.description: Function to copy shop ID to clipboard and show success/error toast.
